summary.result: The results also indicated that Pinus densiflora in Gangwon, Pinus koraiensis, and Larix leptolepis are more desirable species for forest management project through the extension of ration age.
summary.background: In this study, it was intended to compare the two methodologies for forest management project through extension of rotation age: Korean Forest Carbon Offset Standard (KFOS) and Verified Carbon Standard (VCS).
summary.method: Due to the different approach for estimation of baseline carbon removal, the estimated offset credits were also different according to the two methodologies.
